command.description: The shell command line to type and submit

title.description: The new tab's short title, such as dev server

run_outside_sandbox.description: Ask the user to start the tab outside the OS sandbox. Only after the sandbox refused the command, or when you know it cannot work in the sandbox

description.description: A short label of what this call works on or looks for, shown to the user as its row: a noun phrase of 2 to 6 words, no leading verb
